recommendation: Keep the source change as-is. It implements the OO resolution path for the seed issue and preserves basedOn semantics; FHIR-32698 can receive a separate audit later if needed, but no broader neighborhood sweep was necessary here.
issue_request: FHIR-14675 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution after reporting that ObservationDefinition documentation said Observation.basedOn referenced ObservationDefinition while Observation.basedOn did not permit Reference(ObservationDefinition). The final resolution pointed to related applied Observation/ObservationDefinition work rather than adding ObservationDefinition to basedOn.
initial_application: No existing Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-14675 was present on the combined branch, and local history searches found no Jira-keyed application commit for FHIR-14675 or FHIR-30791 touching the relevant Observation sources. Current source and the live CI profile still lacked Observation.instantiates[x].
additional_context: FHIR-30791 is the related applied Observation/ObservationDefinition issue cited by the seed resolution, while FHIR-32698 later states explicitly that Observation.instantiates[x] should be canonical(ObservationDefinition) or Reference(ObservationDefinition) per FHIR-14675. FHIR-39201 is broader background about instantiates naming and does not supersede the Observation-specific Reference option.
reconciliation: Updated the active Observation StructureDefinition source to add Observation.instantiates[x] with canonical and Reference types targeting ObservationDefinition. Observation.basedOn remains limited to plan, proposal, and order targets because ObservationDefinition is not one of those workflow artifacts.
source_changes: source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml: added Observation.instantiates[x] with canonical and Reference types constrained to http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/ObservationDefinition.
